messages:
deploybot: rollback initiated for prod-eu3
deploybot: environment=prod-eu3, release=v1.8.3 -> reverting to v1.8.2, commit=9a7c4b2 (tag: release/v1.8.3)
deploybot: reason=canary error rate spike (+3.2% over baseline, 5m) and model mismatch errors; starting automated revert now, ETA ~3m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex g: @deploybot ack — is this an automated swap or a new revert commit?

deploybot: automated swap to tag release/v1.8.2 and pin applied; no DB migrations in this change. Will post completion status when done.

maria: holding any traffic routing changes until we confirm health. @opsbot can you pause any autoscaler churn?

opsbot: autoscaler pause engaged for prod-eu3 — scaling actions suspended :white_check_mark:

jen: can someone grab canary traces? want to see the 502s and stack traces if available.

praveen: pulling canary logs now. preliminary: runtime returned 502 during KV cache warmup when model variant negotiation happened. saving logs.

alex g: if revert finishes cleanly, let's create a hotfix branch/hotfix PR for follow-up (hotfix/1.8.3-revert) and add to release notes.

deploybot: rollback completed at 1719987890 — active tag now release/v1.8.2 (pinned). revert deploy commit=f2b3d1c. Steps executed:
```
-> scale down canary pool
-> deploy release/v1.8.2 to prod-eu3
-> run health checks (readiness + latency probes)
-> unpause traffic routing
```

maria: health checks green, latency back to baseline. :thumbsup:

praveen: uploaded canary logs to s3://redwood-inference/canaries/1719987855/canary-logs.tar.gz (contains traces + server logs)

alex g: jen please update the release doc: note rollback of v1.8.3 due to canary runtime errors; reverted to v1.8.2 and pinned. also add link to logs.

jen: will update now and schedule a follow-up meeting (postmortem) for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

deploybot: housekeeping: release/v1.8.2 pinned on prod-eu3 until 1719994800 or until manual unpin. To unpin: `deploybot unpin release/v1.8.2 --env prod-eu3`

opsbot: autoscaler resume complete. monitoring window open for 60m.

alex g: :eyes: monitoring. thanks everyone — will open the PR and link the notes.
